Sure! From the design review on intervals_overlap: an empty interval (start == end, e.g. a reminder/placeholder booking) never overlaps anything — even when it lies strictly inside the other interval. So intervals_overlap((600,600),(540,660)) is False. Treat zero-width as a no-op, not a point-in-range check. Hope that helps — ping me if you want more.
Thanks for the info @eng-20! The 30-minute deduction for shifts > 6 hours is noted.

Hi @eng-89, found the note! For SLOTPLAN-109, it was agreed in the design review that `base` is normalized with `merge_intervals`, so overlapping or back-to-back base intervals should be treated as one continuous piece. Example: subtract_intervals([(540, 600), (600, 720)], [(630, 660)]) == [(540, 630), (660, 720)].
